title: Canonical section data for rank-one purity
statement: For a small site J and a coefficient ring A, sections is evaluation of the underlying module presheaf. For the affine-line datum [def-pur-affine-line-datum], openObject and restriction are its actual punctured open and inclusion. The kernel section complex and its snake boundary specify IsBoundary. The free abelian sheaf on a representable represents evaluation; its cocycle-normalized Ext comparison defines kummerClass by composing the represented unit, the Kummer extension and the coefficient map. comparisonSections is the evaluated etale/pro-etale adjunction unit, and comparisonCohomology its right-derived base change. constantUnit is pullback of a scalar unit to the punctured line.

proof.text: Construct evaluation and the open restriction directly. Build the short complex from the actual kernel inclusion and restriction. Define IsBoundary by transport of the snake boundary on every injective resolution.

Use free abelian Yoneda and its naturality for evaluationRepresented. Choose the uniquely cocycle-normalized Ext comparison and compose the Kummer extension with the represented unit and coefficient map. Derive the evaluated comparison unit to obtain comparisonCohomology.
